{"consolidated_memory":"Stale state in ui/state/cacheSlice.ts - two separate incidents (2026-05-07 and 2026-06-03)

SHARED CONTEXT:
- File: ui/state/cacheSlice.ts (web ui side)
- Problem: stale state in the cache slice
- Symptom: old value still in the store snapshot
- Repro: edit a record then navigate back to the list

INCIDENT 1: 2026-05-07 (c029-e0)
- Root cause: race in lazy initialisation
- Trigger: turned up only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #6229 on branch fix/stale-state-1
- Outcome: backlog cleared 53 minutes after the deploy

INCIDENT 2: 2026-06-03 (c029-e1)
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Trigger: turned up only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #7257 on branch fix/stale-state-2
- Outcome: nightly rollup matched the source counts for 46 days running"}
